listed_quote.quote: (NASDAQ: ARCC) announced today that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of American Capital, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ACAS)

announcement.quote: ARES CAPITAL CORPORATION TO ACQUIRE AMERICAN CAPITAL, LTD IN TRANSACTION VALUED AT $3.4 BILLION

outcome_evidence.quote: ARES CAPITAL CORPORATION COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF AMERICAN CAPITAL, LTD.

deals.notes: Cash and stock consideration; ARCC stockholders approved on 2016-12-15 and the completion 8-K followed on 2017-01-03. Both are business development companies (the merger text refers to American Capital's election as a business development company).
